crossRefs.note: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Defend the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”

translations.web: Don’t oppress the widow, nor the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’
translations.bsb: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, the foreigner or the poor. And do not plot evil in your hearts against one another.’
translations.kjv: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.
translations.asv: and oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the sojourner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.
